title: THE BLOOD OF DRAGONS // THE LOST VALYRIAN ROLLS
narrative: Deep in the sealed archives beneath the Honeywine, Sam breaks the red wax seal of Septon Barth's Unnatural History. The suppressed pages describe the origins of dragons—not born of natural biology, but spliced from wyrms and human blood by Valyrian sorcerers. Crucially, the margin notes contain the exact recipe for forging Valyrian steel using dragonglass dust and high-carbon iron.

options.text: Send the secret metallurgy formulas north to Castle Black.
Deliver the scrolls to Daenerys to tame her untamed dragons.
